scope: Public, indexed Purdue/archives source checks for AHF-identified exterior photographs, elevations, and plans; not an exhaustive request of uncatalogued archival holdings.
queries: site:archives.lib.purdue.edu/repositories "Animal Holding Facility" Purdue Phase III
Purdue Campus Facilities and Buildings Historic Database record Animal Holding Facility
findings: The official Purdue Libraries AHF building-detail record (id 294) was retrieved directly; its top-level image_url is null and both construction phases have empty images arrays. The record contains eight history/financial-report citations, but no embedded exterior photographs, elevations, or plans.

The official historic record lists 24,687 sq ft for the 2001-present phase (about 2,293.50 m2), within 0.6% of the 2,280.05 m2 GIS footprint area; gross-floor-area versus polygon conventions are unspecified, so this is a plausibility cross-check only.
Purdue Archives search returns a corporate-name entry for Animal Holding Facility (West Lafayette, Ind.) but no indexed AHF-identified exterior image, elevation, or plan in the searched results.

The AHF-linked Board of Trustees citations and Purdue financial reports were checked as public finding-aid targets; they establish project/history context but no AHF-specific public elevation or facade image was located.
A public Street View lookup for 410 S University St did not yield identifiable AHF street-level imagery.
Search results concerning construction or adjacent veterinary buildings were not treated as AHF facade evidence.
No facade, entrance, window pattern, or roof-edge detail is modeled from inference. The neutral envelope remains explicitly unverified.
limitations: A null image URL and no relevant public search results do not establish that no photographs or drawings exist in uncatalogued or access-restricted Purdue Archives holdings.
